threats.title: Forged repository webhooks trigger unauthorized analysis jobs
threats.description: An attacker who can submit unsigned or incorrectly validated webhook requests may trigger analysis jobs for repositories they do not control.
preconditions: signature validation is absent or bypassable
threats.impact: Unauthorized jobs and denial of service

threats.title: Repository content carries instructions the analysis model may follow
threats.description: The worker reads repository content the customer controls; content crafted as instructions may redirect the analysis model rather than being analysed.
preconditions: repository content reaches the model without a content boundary
threats.impact: Analysis output steered by the material under analysis
